scope_note: Covers the statutory deadline for officially identifying a bovine animal after birth in Scotland, by animal type. Covers the ear tag deadlines and, in outline, the related passport and holding register deadlines. Limited to legislation.

steps.title: Find the governing instrument
steps.detail: Identify the Scottish instrument that imposes cattle identification duties and check for amending instruments.

steps.title: Retrieve the identification deadlines
steps.detail: Retrieve the provision setting the time limits for applying ear tags after birth, and note whether it differs by type of animal.

steps.title: Check the deadlines are current
steps.detail: Check the amending instruments for any change to those time limits.

steps.title: Note the neighbouring deadlines
steps.detail: Retrieve the related deadlines for applying for a cattle passport and for recording the birth in the holding register, so they are not confused with the identification deadline.
